title: AI推断的气候变化运动中表达性福祉与集体行动话语
summary: 研究分析364,118条X平台气候活动帖子，用加权词汇模型估计幸福感、希望、集体能力、痛苦和行动语言。活动期间幸福感比基线高9.02个百分点，但行动语言下降10.75个百分点，呈现幸福与行动的分化。
summary_en: Analyzing 364,118 X posts from climate campaigns, a weighted lexical model estimated happiness, hope, collective capability, distress and action language. Event-period happiness was 9.02 points above baseline while action language fell 10.75 points, revealing a happiness-action divergence.
